prTitle: feat: IBR-14721-tag support tag with md

analysis.summary: The PR introduces Markdown support for badges but leaves the `Badge` type definition inconsistent with its usage in the component, which will break React rendering and footnote display logic.

bugs.title: Missing `code` property in `Badge` type causes broken React keys and footnotes
bugs.description: The `Badge` type definition updated in this PR (lines 204-210) does not include a `code` property. However, the `PromoBadge` component relies on `badge.code` for its React list keys and for looking up footnote translations.
bugs.risk: At runtime, `badge.code` will be `undefined`. This causes all badges to share the same React key (`undefined`), leading to incorrect UI reconciliation and state bugs. Additionally, footnote lookups will resolve to `badge/undefined`, causing all badge footnotes to fail to render.

notBugs.reason: While placing Markdown (which may render block elements) inside a Tag component could potentially lead to invalid HTML nesting (e.g., div inside span), this is a styling/linting concern rather than a high-severity functional runtime error.
The use of `as string` on `badge.name` is redundant because the type definition already declares it as a string, but this has no impact on runtime behavior or correctness.
